business_summary: Shaanxi Panlong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. researches and develops, produces, and sells Chinese patent medicines and traditional Chinese medicine formula granules in China. The company offers orthopedic, cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, digestive, respiratory, pediatrics, gynecology, hepatobiliary, rheumatism and bone injury, tonic, heat-clearing and detoxifying, and liver and gallbladder drugs, as well as supplements and traditional Chinese medicine anti-inflammatory products. It also offers health food, health products, functional health food, and daily chemical products. The company was formerly known as Shaanxi Panlong Pharmaceutical Group Limited By Share Ltd and changed its name to Shaanxi Panlong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. in May 2026. Shaanxi Panlong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Xi'an, China.
business_summary_ko: 산시반용제약그룹유한회사는 중국에서 중국 특허 의약품과 한약 제제 과립을 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 정형외과, 심혈관, 뇌혈관, 소화기, 호흡기, 소아과, 산부인과, 간담도, 류머티즘 및 뼈 손상, 강장제, 해열제 및 해독제, 간 및 담낭 약물뿐만 아니라 보충제 및 한약 항염증 제품도 제공합니다. 그 밖에도 건강식품, 건강식품, 건강기능식품, 생활화학제품 등을 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Shaanxi Panlong Pharmaceutical Group Limited By Share Ltd로 알려졌으며 2026년 5월에 Shaanxi Panlong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Shaanxi Panlong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.는 1997년에 설립되었으며 중국 시안(Xi'an)에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
